sycbekjy.sourceDescription: Emitting a snowy charm, the all-in-one decoration features 81 branch tips that are made of 100% new PVC. In addition, the 3 ft Xmas tree comes with lush pine needles, eucalyptus leaves, natural pine cones, and red berries that add a realistic touch. Plus, 20 warm white LED lights offer 8 lighting modes, including combination, in wave, slo glo, sequential, chasing/flash, slow fade, twinkle/flash, and steady on. Moreover, the tree features a timer for 6 hours and off for 18 hours. Its stable metal base is filled with cement and ensures high security, while the silver appearance looks elegant. Bring the adaptable ambiance to your space, enjoy the winter wonderland, and step into a festive forest where every branch tells a story. Merry Christmas! Snowy and Luxuriant Charm: Step into the magic of winter with the 3 ft Xmas tree with up to 81 snowy branch tips that are made of 100% new PVC. Thus, the tabletop tree is fireproof, non-allergic, anti-fading, and smell-free for safe family use. Perfect Simulation Effect: The Christmas tree boasts lush pine needles for a full look. The tree is also adorned with 8 clusters of eucalyptus leaves, 5 natural pine cones and 8 clusters of red berries, bringing a touch of realism to your holiday setup. Illuminating Elegance: Light up your festive evenings with the Xmas tree’s 20 warm white LED lights. With 8 lighting modes, you can choose the ideal setting to match your mood. Plus, the auto timer keeps the lights on for 6 hours and off for 18 hours. Weighted Metal Base: The tabletop Xmas tree comes with a metal base that is filled with cement for unmatched stability. This robust foundation prevents any tilting or tipping, ensuring that your tree always stands firm. Versatile Decoration: The Christmas tree is not just a decoration but a delightful way to convey your best wishes. Ideal for decorating tabletops in your home, office, school, and more, the tree will be a heartwarming centerpiece. hrhgjnwj.baseName: Christmas Tree World 7ft Pre-Lit Slim Wildhorn Pine - Warm White Lights
hrhgjnwj.variantName: Christmas Tree World 7ft Pre-Lit Slim Wildhorn Pine - Warm White Lights
hrhgjnwj.sourceDescription: Enjoy a festive glow with the 7ft Pre-lit Slim Wildhorn Pine. This elegant artificial Christmas tree combines lifelike pine needle foliage with 400 multi-function warm white LED lights in a slender shape, making it a lovely choice for smaller living rooms, apartments and cosy corners. Featuring distinctive short-cut pine needle foliage, the Slim Wildhorn Pine has traditional PVC tips tucked towards the centre. These add depth and fullness, while the outer branches give a natural appearance. It offers a beautifully full look within a narrow silhouette. It has gently upswept branches and a slim, tapered shape, with natural green shades and subtle brown detailing. At 7ft tall, it brings height to your festive display while keeping its footprint compact. Warm white LEDs highlight the needles, with multiple lighting effects to suit your display. The tree comes in three sections, with hinged branches for easy assembly and a supportive metal stand. Spread inner PVC tips before shaping the outer pine needle branches. Wear long sleeves and the included gloves when fluffing the prickly pine needles. Designed for indoor use only, with Christmas Tree World's 10-year foliage and branch guarantee and a 1-year guarantee on the lights. Please note: Accessories in the images are not included with purchase. Crafted from superior PVC material, this Xmas tree is safe and enduring, ensuring it remains vibrant and fresh throughout the season. Setting up is a breeze with the sturdy folding metal stand and protective gloves included. The slim pencil shape allows for versatile placement in any space, perfect for adding festive cheer to your home, office, school, or other settings. Let this Xmas tree bring joy and beauty to your celebrations. Merry Christmas! Lush Branch Tips: Up to branch tips create a realistic and richly textured look that emulates the charm of a natural tree. Besides, branches of the Xmas tree boast a unique bullet-shaped design, making the holiday decoration more exquisite. Romantic Lighting: Illuminate your festive celebrations with warm white LED lights pre-strung on the Christmas tree. The energy-saving LED lights cast a gentle glow that enhances the holiday ambiance and come with a UKCA-certificated adaptor. Advanced PVC Material: The Xmas tree is made of 100% new PVC that is not only fireproof but also non-allergic and anti-fading. This premium material ensures your tree remains vibrant and smell-free, providing a fresh and safe space. Easy Setup System: Set up the Christmas tree effortlessly this season with multiple superior features, including a sturdy folding metal stand with a preinstalled bolt for ideal hole alignment. Plus, 2 pairs of gloves are included to protect your hands. Slim Pencil Shape: Designed to fit any space, the slim pencil-shaped Xmas tree offers the great versatility for wide use. Its elegant, slender profile allows you to bring the festive spirit into your home, office, shop, school, carnival, etc. Specifications Color: Green Material: PVC, Metal Tree Height: 180 cm Tree Width: 38 cm Number of Branch Tips: 390 Number of LED Lights: 180 Number of Sections: 3 Net Weight: 3 kg Box Qty:1(May vary by batch) Package Includes: 1 x Christmas Tree 2 x Pairs of Gloves 1 x User Guide Retain instructions for future reference.always place the product on a flat, steady and stable surface.keep all small parts and packaging materials for this product away from babies and children as they potentially pose a serious choking hazard. FDS CORPORATION LIMITED Unit 4, Blackacre Road, Great Blakenham, Ipswich, United Kingdom, IP6 0FL

a8emdh67.sourceDescription: This Modern Artificial Christmas Tree is a pristine embodiment of contemporary style blended with classic holiday spirit. Designed to bring life and light to any room or outdoor shelter, its lush green branches made from durable PVC and PE offer a realistic and lasting appearance. Perfect for both indoor and sheltered outdoor use, the tree stands as a centerpiece of seasonal décor, effortlessly transforming any living room, garden, or terrace into a festive wonderland, suitable for gatherings, celebrations, or quiet family moments. Quality Materials: Crafted from a durable combination of PVC and PE, this tree stands out for its ability to mimic the natural look and feel of a genuine Christmas tree, ensuring it remains a cherished part of your seasonal décor for years. Sturdy Construction: Supported by a robust iron stand, the tree remains firm and stable, providing a sound foundation for your holiday ornaments and lights, thus safeguarding your seasonal decorations from tilting or toppling over. Modern Design: This tree adopts a sleek, modern design with minimal ornamentation, making it a versatile choice for spaces that value simplicity without sacrificing festive spirit. This design exudes timeless elegance, ensuring it complements various décor styles seamlessly. Seasonal Versatility: Perfect for both living rooms and sheltered outdoor areas, this tree engages the holiday spirit in diverse environments. Its adjustable features provide the flexibility to fit within different spatial setups, making it truly adaptable. Easy Maintenance: The tree comes with straightforward assembly instructions, requiring just a screwdriver and the efforts of two people, making it a convenient choice for those looking to decorate with minimal fuss during the busy holiday rush. Product Specifications Colour: Green Material: PVC, pe and steel Tree height: 210 cm Bottom diameter: 105 cm Stand size: 46.5 x 46.5 cm Durable Indoor and sheltered outdoor use Assembly required: Yes Delivery-contains: 1 x Artificial Christmas tree • By choosing FSC certified products, you are supporting responsible management of the world's forests. This artificial tree is intended exclusively for indoor festive decoration. Assemble the product on a flat, stable surface using the provided stand to prevent tipping, which could cause injury or property damage. Keep this item away from open flames, candles, fireplaces, and space heaters, as synthetic materials can melt or catch fire under extreme heat. If using electric lights, ensure they are safety-certified and do not leave them turned on unattended. This product is not a toy; keep small parts, detachable ornaments, and packaging away from young children and pets to prevent choking or suffocation. Store in a cool, dry place when not in use to ensure long-term structural safety. WALPLUS, Unit 124, Anglesey Business Park, Littleworth Road, Hednesford, WS12 1NR, United Kingd
